source.label: Placed in M33 as the app draws it, where the star's sight line crosses the disc's midplane: 858,496 pc (src/objects/m33-layers/source/recipe.json: centre 859,014 pc from the Local Volume Database v1.1.1 (Pace 2025), inclination 54 deg, line of nodes 22.5 deg). The galaxy's Cepheid distance, Breuval et al. (2023), ApJ 951, 118, abstract: modulus 24.622 +/- 0.03 mag, 840 kpc; it places the galaxy, not a star within it

controls.label: Color
controls.qualification: Colour of a blackbody at the star's temperature; darkening toward the edge from a model atmosphere. The disc itself is unresolved.
controls.notes: The colour of a blackbody at the star's published temperature. The darkening toward the edge is the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 4,900 K and log g 0.75 (u1 0.652, u2 0.115): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used. The spin axis's direction on the sky is a display convention.

physical.credit: Groenewegen radius; Breuval et al. (2023), ApJ 951, 118, table 9 position; cited distance; no measured rotation axis (display convention)
